usage: icebath secrets [-h] {bitwarden,bw,onepassword,op,1password} ...

Pull API keys from an external secret manager at process startup instead of storing them in
~/.icebath/.env. Supports Bitwarden Secrets Manager and 1Password. See: https://hermes-
agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/secrets/

positional arguments:
  {bitwarden,bw,onepassword,op,1password}
    bitwarden (bw)      Bitwarden Secrets Manager integration
    onepassword (op, 1password)
                        1Password (op:// references) integration

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
